description: Nivellementpunkte der Stadt Bremerhaven is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The dataset contains all urban levelling points (elevation points) with the current height. At the same time, sketches and photos are provided to identify the points. Altitude fixed points form the basis for further detailed and engineering surveys, e.g. for road construction, railway and waterway construction, for the production of topographic maps and geophysical work. Coverage: the city of Bremerhaven. The portal shows the English title as "Levelling points of the city of Bremerhaven" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Höhenprofil, NivP, Festpunkte, Nivellementpunkt, Höhenpunkt, Nivellementpunkte. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
